dossier.scp_unleashed.472.title: The Bloodstone
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.caption: SCP-472 at intake, set on felt beside a scale rule. Every microphone in the room recorded a slow pulse.
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.0.text.0: SCP-472 is kept in a sealed chamber at the far end of an otherwise empty wing, with a wide margin of unused rooms on every side. The chamber is not staffed. Observation is carried out by remote camera only, and the audio feed from the chamber stays muted.
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.0.text.1: SCP-472 is to remain wrapped in its padded transit cloth whenever it is moved, and it is not to be set down anywhere but its chamber. **No one is to remain near SCP-472 once it has been set down.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.0.text.2: Any staff member who reports hearing a heartbeat that is not their own is to be escorted out of the wing at once.
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.1.text.0: SCP-472 is a single smooth gemstone of a deep oxblood red, oval and domed like a polished cabochon, roughly twelve centimetres across. It has no facets or seams. The surface is glossy and warm to the touch, the core is so dark it looks almost black, and a faint red light can be seen moving inside it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.1.text.1: While SCP-472 rests on a surface, everyone nearby hears a slow heartbeat. The sound seems to come from the object, but it has never been recorded clearly. Subjects who stay near SCP-472 report that the heartbeat grows louder and quicker for them in particular, and the effect builds faster the closer they stand.
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.1.text.2: Prolonged exposure brings a reddening at the edges of vision, then fleeting images of eyes and unfamiliar markings, and faint whispering. Subjects then describe a strong conviction that SCP-472 is hungry. Past this point they begin to come to physical harm. %rThe process has not been observed to its end since Incident 472-1.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.1.text.3: While SCP-472 is wrapped and carried, it is silent.
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.2.title: Addendum 472-1: Exposure Logs
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.2.text.0: Exposure 472-02: a researcher was stationed at an observation window while SCP-472 rested on a bench in the next room. He reported a slow, heavy pulse that kept time with nothing in the room. After several minutes he asked whether anyone else could see red at the corners. He was withdrawn, and said the pulse stopped the moment he left the wing.
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.2.text.1: Exposure 472-05: D-6624 was told to sit beside SCP-472. After roughly two minutes D-6624 said: "It's hungry. Can't you feel it? It's so hungry." D-6624 was recalled shortly afterwards. %rResult withheld.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.2.text.2: Exposure 472-07: two researchers entered the chamber together. Each described the heartbeat as faster than the other did.
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.3.title: Addendum 472-2: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.472.page.3.text: SCP-472 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file. See field notes.
block.scp_unleashed.scp472_bloodstone.to: A smooth, polished stone of a red so dark it is almost black. It is warm, and heavier than it looks.
block.scp_unleashed.scp472_bloodstone.de: It stays quiet while it is carried.
Set it down somewhere far from anyone.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp472_bloodstone: SCP-472, The Bloodstone, is a smooth, polished gemstone of a red so deep it is almost black, domed like a large cabochon garnet. A faint light moves inside it.
Once it is set down, a slow heartbeat can be heard around it. Those who stay close to it for long do not stay well. It is quiet while it is carried.
It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-472 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A courier in Foundation dress will bring it to you.
death.attack.scp_unleashed.scp472_consum: %1$s was consumed by the Bloodstone while fighting %2$s
archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp472.0: Keep it wrapped until it is where it will stay.
message.scp_unleashed.scp472.hungry.0: It's hungry. I can feel it.
message.scp_unleashed.scp472.hungry.1: Why does it feel so hungry?
message.scp_unleashed.scp472.hungry.2: It wants something. I think it wants me.
message.scp_unleashed.scp472.hungry.3: I can't stop listening to it.
message.scp_unleashed.scp472.hungry.4: It's starving. How do I even know that?
